output.reason: [ev-4e7b065b85d5] says the legacy `--log_rotate_*` flag options were removed. An environment is exposed only if it still passes one of these flags to a workload, which is the standard cli-flag{name, set} exposure for a removed flag. The evidence names no component, so leaving the condition component-free is correct; limiting it to istiod (as P2 did) could miss exposed environments. The evidence names the flags only as a wildcard family and never lists them one by one, so the `*` in the flag name cannot be replaced with exact names from this evidence, which is why confidence is low.
